competencies.label: Sampling Methodology
competencies.description: Select sampling designs and calculate defensible weights.

competencies.label: Digital Tools
competencies.description: Use spreadsheets and digital survey tools with reproducible checks.

competencies.label: Critical Thinking
competencies.description: Identify assumptions, investigate inconsistencies and justify decisions.

competencies.label: Survey Data Collection
competencies.description: Apply survey instructions and record respondent information accurately.

competencies.label: Communication
competencies.description: Explain statistical tasks clearly and engage respondents respectfully.

competencies.label: Sampling Frames and UFS
competencies.description: Maintain complete, nonoverlapping and identifiable urban sampling units.

competencies.label: Geospatial Tools
competencies.description: Check boundaries and edit geospatial layers for frame maintenance.

competencies.label: Industrial Statistics
competencies.description: Interpret enterprise variables and validate industrial survey records.

competencies.label: Statistical Analysis
competencies.description: Analyze statistical data with appropriate methods and transparent checks.

competencies.label: Price Statistics
competencies.description: Validate quotations and compile interpretable price indices.

competencies.label: Statistical Computing
competencies.description: Write reproducible statistical data transformations and calculations, including workflows using Python, R and SQL. Broad workflow skill; tool-specific proficiency is separately evidenced in COMP-025, COMP-026 and COMP-027.

competencies.label: National Accounts
competencies.description: Compile and reconcile output, intermediate consumption and GVA estimates.

competencies.label: Statistical Data Management
competencies.description: Manage statistical records, versioning, quality controls and data lifecycles.

competencies.label: Data Privacy and Disclosure Control
competencies.description: Assess disclosure risk and apply defensible statistical protection methods.

competencies.label: Metadata and Dissemination
competencies.description: Prepare definitions, provenance, quality notes and release-ready metadata.

competencies.label: Leadership
competencies.description: Coach staff, delegate work and oversee quality and delivery.

competencies.label: Collaboration
competencies.description: Coordinate handoffs and resolve cross-team dependencies.

competencies.label: Strategic Thinking
competencies.description: Set priorities and justify capability investments using evidence.

competencies.label: Labour Statistics
competencies.description: Calculate weighted labour-force participation, worker-population and unemployment rates with documented denominators. Distinct project competency for Labour Statistics; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Agricultural Statistics
competencies.description: Compile and reconcile weighted crop estimates with uncertainty notes. Distinct project competency for Agricultural Statistics; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: SDG Indicators
competencies.description: Produce a disaggregated indicator table with source, reference period and comparability notes. Distinct project competency for SDG Indicators; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Data Quality Frameworks
competencies.description: Prepare a reproducible quality report with checks, exceptions and corrective actions. Distinct project competency for Data Quality Frameworks; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Survey Design
competencies.description: Design and pilot a questionnaire and document measurement and nonresponse risks. Distinct project competency for Survey Design; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Metadata Standards
competencies.description: Produce and validate a versioned statistical metadata package and crosswalk. Distinct project competency for Metadata Standards; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Python
competencies.description: Build a repeatable data pipeline with functions, tests and documented dependencies. Distinct project competency for Python; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: R
competencies.description: Produce reproducible weighted analysis with diagnostic checks and session metadata. Distinct project competency for R; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: SQL
competencies.description: Build tested multi-table queries that avoid duplicate amplification and handle NULL correctly. Distinct project competency for SQL; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Data Visualization
competencies.description: Build an accessible visual narrative with uncertainty, units and source notes. Distinct project competency for Data Visualization; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: AI/ML
competencies.description: Build a leakage-controlled evaluation and document metrics, bias and limitations. Distinct project competency for AI/ML; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Cloud Computing
competencies.description: Design a logged reproducible data workload with backup and cost controls. Distinct project competency for Cloud Computing; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: APIs
competencies.description: Implement contract-tested pagination, input validation and idempotent write handling. Distinct project competency for APIs; not an official MoSPI definition.

competencies.label: Cybersecurity
competencies.description: Assess a local-service threat model and validate access, logging and patch controls. Distinct project competency for Cybersecurity; not an official MoSPI definition.
